title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] "Delete Invoiced Sales Orders" leaves orphaned Sales Subscription Lines behind
summary: Fixed orphaned Sales Subscription Lines left behind by "Delete Invoiced Sales Orders" and "Delete Invd Blnkt Sales Orders" reports by adding event subscribers and batch deletion procedures on the Sales Header table extension.
key_points: Added two event subscribers in Sales Subscription Line Mgmt. so the Delete Invoiced Sales Orders and Delete Invd Blnkt Sales Orders reports also delete Sales Subscription Lines
Report 299 cleanup hooks OnAfterDeleteSalesLinesLoop so lines are removed even when a Charge (Item) line keeps the order
New public DeleteSalesServiceCommitments() on the Sales Header extension batch-deletes a document's subscription lines and is shared by both reports, Sales-Post and Sales-Quote to Order
DeleteSalesServiceCommitment on Sales Line and the new header procedure are public with XML documentation for external callers
Three new tests cover invoiced orders, blanket orders and posting
